label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

This is a request for new behaviour: export formats are centrally defined as SUPPORTED_FORMATS = ["csv", "xlsx"] in src/exportUtils.ts, with CONTENT_TYPES and the CSV/delimited writer logic (toDelimited, escapeField) also living there. Adding a TSV option (which could reuse toDelimited with a tab delimiter to properly escape descriptions containing commas) would mainly be implemented by extending this file, plus wiring a corresponding writer and content type through src/api/reports.ts and src/export/scheduler.ts.
